title: Canonical direct-image and open-restriction coherence interface
statement: The canonical comparison maps, section coprojections, fibre-product section arrow and the four coherence predicates of the parent, with exactly their original constructions. This module factors their definitions from the theorem so independent source arguments can import them.

proof_origin.place: Composition isomorphism and Canonicity and associativity, expanded using Stacks 08BJ, 070I, 070Y, 0D6E and the existing general-ring open comparison; V4: DirectImageRestrictionNormalized stores the same four conditions as four proof fields of a Prop structure, with the representative field using explicit preadditive projections of the existing module abelian structures. The constructor and projections give equivalence with the former conjunction; the canonical comparison maps are unchanged.
